title: herdr-parallel-worktree config
description: Lives at DATA_DIR/config.json as defined in SKILL.md's Configuration section (the same place in the user's home regardless of install method). Values differ per person, so it is never kept in the repository; if the file is missing, SKILL.md's initialization creates it.

workerArgs.description: Arguments for the worker claude, passed as-is after `herdr agent start ... --`. An empty array uses each worker's settings default permission mode.
